chunks: And he, peace be upon him, was asked about a man who gave the zakat of his wealth to a man while thinking that he was in hardship, but then found him to be well-off.
He said: “It does not suffice for him.”

key_terms.زَكَاةَ: the obligatory alms-tax due on wealth
key_terms.لَا يُجْزِي: does not legally suffice or fulfill the obligation
key_terms.مَالِهِ: his property or wealth from which zakat is paid
key_terms.مُعْسِرٌ: a person believed to be in financial hardship
key_terms.مُوسِرًا: a person who is actually financially well-off

ai.seo_question: Does zakat count if it was given to someone later discovered to be wealthy?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about zakat distribution when it is given to someone mistakenly assumed to be needy. The Imam عليه السلام states that such a payment does not fulfill the obligation if the recipient is actually wealthy.
